(data centre, GPUs)"] E --> F["Validated in simulation
and tests"] F --> G["Over-the-air update"] G --> A

ch04_30.heading: Worked example 5.A: how many TOPS?
ch04_30.code:
flowchart LR I["One accelerator
96 × 96 = 9,216 MACs
2 GHz clock"] --> A["Per accelerator
9,216 × 2 × 2e9 ÷ 1e12
= 36.9 TOPS"] A --> B["Four accelerators
36.9 × 4
= 147.5 TOPS peak"] B --> C["At 40% utilisation
147.5 × 0.4
= 59.0 TOPS usable"]

ch05_01.heading: 1.1 The software stack
ch05_01.code:
flowchart TD A["Application / model code
y = relu(W @ x + b)"] --> B["Framework
PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow
(builds a graph of operations)"] B --> C["Compiler / graph optimiser
XLA, TensorRT, Core ML

ch05_02.heading: Worked example 1.A: why fusion saves memory traffic
ch05_02.code:
flowchart LR T["Tensor
1,000,000 values × 2 bytes
= 2 MB"] --> U["Unfused
3 ops × (read + write) × 2 MB
= 12 MB"] T --> F["Fused
1 read + 1 write × 2 MB
= 4 MB"] U --> R["Saving
12 ÷ 4 = 3×"] F --> R

ch05_03.heading: Worked example 2.A: does our 7B model fit on one chip?
ch05_03.code:
flowchart LR I["7 × 10⁹ parameters
× 16 bytes each"] --> S["Training state
= 112 GB"] S --> C{"Fits on one
96 GB chip?"} C -- "No" --> M["Minimum chips
112 ÷ 96, rounded up
= 2"] S --> H["Sharded 256 ways
112 ÷ 256
≈ 0.44 GB per chip"]

ch05_04.code:
flowchart LR subgraph DP["Data parallel"] direction LR B1["Batch part 1"] --> DA["Chip A
full model"] B2["Batch part 2"] --> DB["Chip B
full model"] DA --> SG["Sum gradients"] DB --> SG end subgraph TP["Tensor parallel"] direction LR TA["Chip A
left half of each layer"] <--> TB["Chip B
right half"] end subgraph PP["Pipeline parallel"] direction LR PA["Chip A
layers 1-10"] --> PB["Chip B

ch05_05.heading: Worked example 2.B: communication overhead for the 7B model
ch05_05.code:
flowchart LR G["Gradients 14 GB
N = 256 chips
100 GB/s per chip"] --> T["Traffic per chip
2 × 255 ÷ 256 × 14 GB
= 27.89 GB"] T --> CM["Communication
27.89 ÷ 100
= 0.28 s"] W["Step work
6 × 7e9 × 4e6 FLOPs
cluster: 256 × 200 TFLOP/s × 40%"] --> CP["Compute
= 8.2 s"] CM --> E["Efficiency
8.2 ÷ (8.2 + 0.28)
= 96.7%"] CP --> E

ch05_06.heading: Worked example 3.A: the price of recomputation
ch05_06.code:
flowchart LR B["Normal step
3 parts = 8.2 s"] --> R["With recomputation
4 parts: 8.2 × 4 ÷ 3
= 10.9 s"] R --> X["Extra compute
4 ÷ 3 − 1
= 33%"]

ch05_07.heading: Worked example 3.B: the speed limit of one conversation
ch05_07.code:
flowchart LR I["Weights 7 GB (INT8)
bandwidth 1 TB/s"] --> T["Time per token
7 GB ÷ 1,000 GB/s
= 7.0 ms"] T --> U["One user
1 ÷ 0.007
≈ 142.9 tokens/s"] U --> B["Batch of 32 users
32 × 142.9
≈ 4,571.4 tokens/s"]

ch05_08.heading: Worked example 3.C: why utilisation is a cost issue
ch05_08.code:

$2 per hour"] --> A["35% utilisation
2 ÷ 0.35
= $5.71 per useful hour"] C --> B["60% utilisation
2 ÷ 0.60
= $3.33 per useful hour"] A --> S["Saving
1 − 0.35 ÷ 0.60
= 41.7%"] B --> S

ch05_09.code:

8,760 hours per year"] --> A["PUE 1.1
1 × 1.1 × 8,760
= 9,636 MWh"] L --> B["PUE 1.6
1 × 1.6 × 8,760
= 14,016 MWh"] A --> D["Difference
= 4,380 MWh"] B --> D D --> M["Cost at $80 per MWh
= $350,400 per year"]

ch05_12.code:
